description: Create a catalog category, optionally nested under an existing one, with optional description and per-language translations. The slug is normalized to Latin whatever is sent. The parent must exist in this workspace, and a name already used under the same parent is rejected, so call list_categories first to avoid duplicates. Translate only the category's own name and description into each locale — add no facts the user did not give. The result is the created category with its id (use it as categoryId for create_product/update_product) and echoes the operating workspace.

description.description: Prose a storefront shows at the top of the category shelf, in the workspace's base language (up to 4000 characters). Send null to clear it.

googleProductCategory.description: Google Product Taxonomy id or full path for this category (for Google Shopping). Separate from the name; send null to clear it.

name.description: The category name in the workspace's base language, up to 120 characters. Must be unique among categories with the same parent.

parentId.description: Id of the parent category from list_categories, to nest this one under it; it must exist in this workspace. Omit or send null for a top-level category.

slug.description: URL segment for the category. Normalized to lowercase Latin letters, digits and hyphens whatever is sent (Cyrillic is transliterated); derived from the name when omitted.

translations.description: Category name (and optional description) per locale. Omit to leave existing translations untouched; when sent it REPLACES the whole set, so an empty array removes them all.

locale.description: Content locale, one of the workspace's supported languages.

name: create_category
title: Create category
